structured.answer: The page sorts things into where the money is held (bank deposit, קרן השתלמות, חשבון ניירות ערך) and what it's invested in (קרן כספית, bonds, S&P 500, and so on). For me the ones worth looking into are an S&P 500 fund through a חשבון ניירות ערך, my existing קרן השתלמות, and a קרן כספית for money I might need soon.

stuck.why: Heading promises cash, מק"מ, קרן כספית, bonds, stocks via index, but 'מסלול כללי' is a managed mix, not one of those; made me doubt the list
Too many similar-looking indices, couldn't tell them apart, just went with S&P because I know it
